CM Samrat Darbhanga Visit : mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri aaj darbhanga pahunchenge. is dauran siem shyama mandir men puja-archana karenge. apne daure par mukhyamantri darbhanga ko karib 330 karor rupye ki vibhinn pariyojnaon ki saugat denge. in pariyojnaon se juri yojnaon aur karyakramon ko lekar logon ki najar mukhyamantri ke daure par rahegi. dekhie darbhanga daure se juri puri khabra.
